test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

The ducks were not afraid of the __fast moving water__.
solution:
The correct **Torrent .**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the question,the **rapidly rushing water** did not frighten the ducks.
 
• Here **"fast moving water"** is a phrase whose meaning is the water with a **great force**.
 
• A **forceful, swiftly** moving stream of water or another liquid is referred to as a torrent.A torrent is a large volume of water falling, flowing, or raging.
 
• So **"Torrent"** is a word which means the **"fast moving water"**

​Therefore, **the correct answer** is **torrent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electrical charge** carriers, often electrons or atoms deficient in electrons, travel as current. **Current** is not suitable for the fast moving water.
 
• A **flood** is an overflow of water (or, in rare cases, other **fluids**) that covers normally dry land. Flood does not have that much of speed like torrent.
 
• **Overflow** means to completely occupy and spread beyond a space. This also does not match with torrent or fast moving water.
 
• Therefore we can conclude that **the ducks were not afraid of the fast moving water** which is like **torrent** .
